title: Marketing: Email Your Customers by What They Bought | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Your orders already say who your customers are. The CrestApps Marketing module groups them into segments by what they bought (lapsed buyers, new customers, repeat buyers, big spenders, a country) and sends email campaigns to a segment, only to customers who agreed to hear from you, with a one-click unsubscribe in every email. It also adds ready-made automations, such as a thank-you email when an order is paid.

In this video:
• Why market from your orders
• Segments: rules about what customers bought
• Campaigns: write one email, test it, send it now or later
• Consent and unsubscribing
• Ready-made automations that email for you
• Use cases
